arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Check for any edge cases with newlines
tests = [
    # Trailing whitespace scenarios
    ('{:s}', ' '),
    ('{:s}\n', ' \n'),
    ('{:S}', '\t\n'),
    ('{:S}\n', '\t\n'),
    
    # Empty input after newline
    ('{}\n', '\n'),
    
    # Multiple newlines
    ('{}', '\n'),
    ('{}\n', '\n\n'),
]

for fmt, text in tests:
    try:
        result = parse.parse(fmt, text)
        print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {text!r}) = {result}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {text!r}) -> ERROR: {e}')
"
